descriptions.normal: A soup prepared by simmering a variety of shredded vegetables with light seasoning. It's mild, flavorful, and great for your health.
descriptions.suspicious: A soup prepared by simmering a variety of shredded vegetables with light seasoning. The long simmer has left the greens soft and limp, a bit mushy in texture. Not exactly appetizing, but it'll fill you up.
descriptions.delicious: A soup prepared by simmering a variety of shredded vegetables with light seasoning. Cooked with simple, minimal techniques, it brings out the purest essence of the vegetables. With just one sip, a comforting warmth spreads from your stomach through your entire body.

effectTexts.normal: Restores 32% of Max HP and an additional 1,250 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.suspicious: Restores 30% of Max HP and an additional 600 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.delicious: Restores 34% of Max HP and an additional 1,900 HP to the selected character.
